subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When reviewing, the reviewer shall generate through the four lenses — spec fidelity, design & convention conformance, security & abuse, correctness critic — and shall ship only candidates that survive independent adversarial screening.
rationale: the class lens pack; screening kills plausible-but-wrong findings
fit_criterion: lens attribution on 100% of findings; the §5.9 catch evals demonstrate each lens (EVAL-1/2/3/7) catching its seeded family; the screen fixture shows a seeded plausible-but-wrong candidate killed before shipping
